notes: Sabadell offers no CSV: its movements download is a TXT ("Histórico de movimientos .txt") or an old .xls. This is the TXT: NO header row, no rows above or below, fields separated by "|", seven per line: F. operativa | Concepto | F. valor | Importe | Saldo | NIF | Referencia. Dates dd/mm/yyyy, amounts signed with decimal comma, running balance after each line, newest first. Only one importer documents the TXT, so the thousands mark (written "1.940,00"), the encoding (Windows-1252, the importer falls back to it) and CRLF line ends are the likeliest forms, not confirmed. The .xls alternative has rows Cuenta:/Divisa:/Titular:/Selección: then F. Operativa | Concepto | F. Valor | Importe | Saldo | Referencia 1 | Referencia 2. Currency never stated.
